data.name: Charulekha
data.long_meaning: The name Charulekha comes from the Sanskrit language, derived from the words 'Charu' meaning moon and 'Lekha' meaning mark. This name represents the idea of a divine mark bestowed upon an individual by the moon. In Hindu mythology, the moon is often associated with knowledge, creativity, and the feminine principle. Charulekha is a name that embodies the power and grace of the lunar deity.
